AI × Music

260,000 AI fakes. One label.

Sony Music has asked platforms to remove more than 260,000 AI-generated tracks that impersonate its artists, up from about 135,000 at the end of March. The same week, a North Carolina man was sentenced to 18 months for an AI streaming scheme, the U.S. Copyright Office opened an inquiry into streaming fraud, and Suno hired a Ticketmaster executive to run its live arm.

Making music with AI is fine. Faking an artist, or faking the streams, is not.
